purpose: Validate a deterministic runtime surface precondition for scoped visual-fallback contracts: the same Safari canvas target must be rejected on the wrong semantic surface before provider selection or click delivery, while the matching surface may proceed through the existing semantic-first P5/P6 path.
requiredClaims: If Safari is already running, execution is blocked before immutable evidence is created.
Two loopback-only Safari surfaces expose the same visual target PROCEED but different deterministic semantic surface markers.
The scoped caller contract includes an exact semantic-text surface precondition outside planner output.
On the wrong surface, the runtime returns SURFACE_PRECONDITION_NOT_MET before perception-provider selection.
On the wrong surface, perception-provider selection count remains zero and no pointer click is delivered.
The wrong-surface page therefore remains action-free even though the same visual target text is present.
On the matching surface, the surface precondition is verified before provider selection.
The planner remains semantic-only and contains no scope, surface precondition, postcondition, provider identity or coordinates.
The normal runTask path remains semantic-first and visual fallback becomes eligible only after structured NO_SEMANTIC_TARGET.
P5D provider selection remains lazy and selects the local macOS Vision text-region provider only after the surface precondition and eligible semantic gap are satisfied.
Real Computer Control delivery returns CLICK_POSTED with semanticConsequenceVerified=false.
CLICK_POSTED is delivery only; VERIFIED_SUCCESS requires independent post-action observation.
No screenshot bytes, OCR payload strings or coordinates are logged in session evidence.
Pointer, Safari, loopback server, runtime/cache and temporary resources are cleaned up and product trees remain clean.
nonClaims: P6D does not enable generic Safari or arbitrary web visual fallback.
P6D does not infer surface identity from application name or target text alone.
P6D does not make a surface precondition mandatory for historical P6C contracts; it is an additive guard for contracts that declare one.
P6D does not put surface identity, scope, provider selection, coordinates or postconditions in planner output.
P6D does not broaden exact matching, gestures, displays or provider capabilities.
P6D does not alter Computer Control runtime contracts or move provider ownership out of Computer Use.
The P6D Safari pages and strings remain test-owned and are not shipped as generic application knowledge.

evidencePolicy.safariUserState: Preflight blocks before session creation if Safari is running; the physical test repeats the guard for races.
evidencePolicy.onFailure: Preserve s01 unchanged, diagnose the exact boundary and create s02 only after a forward-only change justified by evidence.
evidencePolicy.sensitiveData: Only test-owned local surfaces are used. Screenshot bytes, OCR payloads and coordinates remain ephemeral and out of session evidence.

onPass.nextCheckpoint: P7 evidence-backed real-use-case discovery before shipping any built-in application visual-fallback knowledge
